steps.name: 1.1 Retire NEW
steps.acceptance: NO_MATCH cause and no_new policy in verdict.py, shadow_audit and docs updated, listed red tests fixed, stored-NEW receipt replays frozen-equal; changed files 100% lines/branches/functions

steps.name: S0-S3 shared index change
steps.acceptance: suffix constant, end_line and scope fields, read_searchable with every read_symbols caller classified, search_sha, searchable replay snapshot, language and include_tests in the receipt id; private-method receipt replays with differences.frozen == []

steps.name: 1.5 and 1.7 extractor commit
steps.acceptance: TS private/protected members indexed with class named, doc_full, optional contract keys, algorithm_changed fires once; TypeScript tests fail rather than skip when node_modules is absent

steps.name: 1.4 required language parameter
steps.acceptance: check_exists and fetch_similar refuse a missing language with LANGUAGE_REQUIRED and a bad one with LANGUAGE_INVALID before any request; every measurement driver pinned to language all by a test and a census

steps.name: 1.3 Exit gate
steps.acceptance: DISTINCT with no logged search is refused and None fails closed; five new statuses, parse_searched and the RULING_RE edges tested; mutation arms redden named tests

steps.name: 1.2 record_search tool
steps.acceptance: record_search mounted as a fifth reuse tool and greps the same working-tree state its spans come from; unit, mount and stdio tests pass; SKILL.md updated in the same commit; three mutation arms redden named tests

steps.name: 1.6 Tests as a separate scope
steps.acceptance: build and ensure take an optional spec; include_tests=True takes the sweep-only route with its own budget; a default call never reads a test record

steps.name: 1.7 Purpose line, JS roots, dropped entries
steps.acceptance: judge sees doc_full and purpose only when the record has them; script census guard green; dropped entries reported with reasons; cold-sweep call count before and after in the PR

steps.name: 1.8 Index rebuilt during a run
steps.acceptance: probe shows each layer finds a definition written mid-run with a text-derived fake embedder; bound measured on the real tree and committed; INDEX_REFRESH_SLOW tested; isolation test with negative control

steps.name: Phase 1 exit checks
steps.acceptance: full unit tier run last and again at merge, run-census-guards.sh green, coverage gate table shows 100% for every changed file, mutation arms listed in the plan all redden, searchable-entry count before and after in the PR

steps.name: C0 Shared pure moves with direct tests
steps.acceptance: dups.jaccard, harness_runner.run_parallel, need_writer.name_hits and vector_build.embed_all moved without changing any result; each has a direct test against literal values or a golden captured at d0bd4f604; existing run_all and own_words_found tests pass unchanged

steps.name: C1 Freeze machinery
steps.acceptance: build_config takes backend, temperature and unscorable_policy with no default; freeze raises CONFIG_UNDECIDED while backend or temperature is empty, CONFIG_DRIFT on any changed field, CONFIG_ALREADY_FROZEN on a second freeze; aggregate_runs raises POLICY_UNDECIDED on an unscorable report while the policy is empty; mutation arms redden named tests

steps.name: C2 Extraction
steps.acceptance: Python via py_index.extract_python plus end_line, text, calls, nodes, declared; TypeScript and JavaScript via the opt-in bodies flag on shapes() with no third walker; completeness raises EXTRACT_INCOMPLETE; a Python SyntaxError file lands in skipped_python; the shapes output without the flag equals a golden captured at d0bd4f604; ts_extract.js 100% under c8 via extract.test.ts on a verified-idle :8000, with doc-lint-ts-counts.json regenerated; extraction census over 207 script files closes with zero skipped

steps.name: C3 Blindness
steps.acceptance: scrub holds only reuse-tool-unique strings; assert_blind raises BLINDNESS_BREACH; identical definitions under two worktree paths give identical prompts; candidate order is stable under reordering; the blindness census over the frozen server and the existing client reports zero breaches, with a positive control

steps.name: C4 Candidates
steps.acceptance: embedding, word and structural lists fused with depth=list_depth, limit 10, head 2; jscpd added as a pinned dependency; a real jscpd report parsed; the live jscpd test fails (never skips) when node or jscpd is missing; the 50% clone cover boundary is covered by a mutation arm

steps.name: C5 Judge
steps.acceptance: one call per new definition through model_transport, harness_runner.run_parallel and the Ledger; no call cap set; unreadable replies retried once; resume makes no repeat call; a parallel failure keeps finished records; OR rule on pair verdicts

steps.name: C6 Clusters and the score
steps.acceptance: surplus per 100 passing tests matches the hand-worked cases; an unscorable run (EXTRACT_INCOMPLETE, NO_PASSING_TESTS, BLINDNESS_BREACH, RUN_INCOMPLETE) writes a report with its cause and exits 2, each cause tested; a scored run exits 0

steps.name: C7 Proof code
steps.acceptance: planted rewrites and Opus work-alikes, monolith pairs with source tags, banned_names, strip_names, select_originals, evaluate_bar at exact thresholds, the self-agreement count (hand-worked 4/5 flag against 2/5 four-way, one-pass pairs excluded), per-stratum figures with intervals and the append-only proof ledger tested, with mutation arms

steps.name: C8 Live smoke and throughput measurement
steps.acceptance: 20 real definitions judged through the Max-plan door in the 10 a.m. to 1 p.m. Eastern window; a smoke file records date, host, sha, config sha, seconds per call, failure rate and the concurrency that held; a failure rate above the stated bound reopens the backend decision

steps.name: Rick decides P4 (judge temperature) and P5
steps.acceptance: Rick has named the judge backend and its temperature (Max plan, which cannot set one, or the work server at 0) and the unscorable policy; both fields are filled in the config template

steps.name: Rick approves the frozen prompt; freeze is committed
steps.acceptance: Rick has approved the prompt text, freeze is committed with backend, temperature and unscorable_policy filled, and the config sha is recorded

steps.name: Rick nominates monolith pairs
steps.acceptance: Rick has named the nominated monolith pairs (source nominated)

steps.name: Rick and the second reviewer label the proof set
steps.acceptance: every planted pair, monolith pair and flag is labelled blind and independently by both people through the packet tool of Phase 3 step D5

steps.name: Run the proof
steps.acceptance: proof_run passes 80% found, 80% of flags right and 90% self-agreement on the flag, with every run kept in the proof ledger, the pool size and each stratum printed

steps.name: Rick names the passing proof record
steps.acceptance: Rick has named the passing record and the frozen commit used for scoring

steps.name: D1 Schema, quota and the draw
steps.acceptance: plan_quota without kind_split raises KIND_SPLIT_UNSET; with a split it sums to 240 ts, 160 py, 300 matched, 100 none via quota_split.quotas; draw raises QUOTA_UNFILLABLE naming the cell; the manifest records the seed, kind table and source commit before the first draft

steps.name: Rick finds the second reviewer
steps.acceptance: a second reviewer is named and available for labelling

steps.name: D2 Seeds and key evidence
steps.acceptance: seed pool, stripped need input, twin groups through reuse_need_check.twin_groups and a dups adapter, and key evidence built; work-alike candidates by the vector route and the sampled route, with selection_route recorded; tests include a neighbour only the sampled route finds

steps.name: D3a identifier_tokens TypeScript branch
steps.acceptance: identifier_tokens on a real TypeScript signature returns names only: no string, number or other TS_TYPE_WORDS; destructured, rest, generic and default parameters covered; Python behaviour unchanged

steps.name: D3 Drafting
steps.acceptance: needs drafted by Fable through run_parallel and the Ledger after a 10-need live smoke that uses a test-only split and commit and marks every row smoke: true that also measures the sampled route's yield; leak_check passes before the checker sees a draft; replacements are reported per cell and reason with the original seed list kept

steps.name: D4 Second model check
steps.acceptance: a second model checks every drafted key and records agreement

steps.name: D5 Labelling tools
steps.acceptance: select_for_labelling, blind packet export with PACKET_LEAK, kappa and dispute tools tested by hand-worked cases

steps.name: Rick names the source commit and fills in the kind split (P6)
steps.acceptance: Rick has named the source commit and filled in the kind_split table; the manifest records who set it and when

steps.name: Rick and the second reviewer label blind
steps.acceptance: both reviewers have labelled every packet item independently

steps.name: Rick breaks the ties
steps.acceptance: every disputed item has Rick's tiebreak recorded

steps.name: D6 Finalize and verify
steps.acceptance: 400 labelled needs finalized with keys, no smoke rows, and verify_manifest passing; needset-status.json is committed as pending until the flip

steps.name: Rick flips the needset status to final
steps.acceptance: needset-status.json reads final in the commit that adds needset-final.jsonl and needset-manifest.json, and the census test passes

steps.name: D7 Statistics
steps.acceptance: the 95% miss-rate bound comes from harness_report.upper_bound, pinned to 0.0099 for 0 in 300 and 0.0256 for 3 in 300 against an independent bisection; kappa tested by hand-worked cases in Phase 3 step D5

steps.name: D8 Loss tracing
steps.acceptance: loss-report produced from the Phase 1 checker through a ledgered, resumable probe with the isolation profile; lost_at counts by kind, language and selection_route; ALT_MATCH and FALSE_MATCH listed for review; miss rate and bound computed after confirmations

steps.name: Reviewers confirm ALT_MATCH and FALSE_MATCH items
steps.acceptance: Rick and the second reviewer have ruled every ALT_MATCH and FALSE_MATCH item; confirmed alternatives are added to their keys and the affected needs are re-traced

phases.name: Five scored pairs
phases.expand_trigger: Rick gives the build checkpoint go after Phase 6

phases.name: Scoring, stop rule and report
phases.expand_trigger: Phases 3 and 7 close; Rick decides P5
